open_obligations: Check the size of the judge-accuracy gain in both studies before treating this as support
Note the authors' debaters are different model families, not best-of-N variants of one model as in much of Khan et al.

Note the setting difference: the authors report Elo results aggregated across tasks, with Pro 1.0 as one of their judges, while Khan et al. use GPT-4-Turbo to judge self-play debates; the authors say Khan et al.'s finding may not generalise that robustly to tasks other than QuALITY
out.other_title: Self-play debate: judge accuracy rises with debater aggregate rating
out.rationale: Khan et al. find judge accuracy rises with debater Elo; the authors explicitly report rough agreement, with a smaller and less consistent effect, and suggest Khan et al.'s finding may not generalise that robustly to tasks other than QuALITY.
out.scope: proposed SUPPORTS: Positive relation between debater persuasiveness (Elo) and judge accuracy
